# Topological Quantum Field Theory

TQFT investigates quantum invariants that are strictly metric-independent, providing robust protection against local decoherence.

## Anyonic Braiding and Invariants

Anyons in $2+1$ dimensions exhibit fractional statistics:

$$
\psi(r_1, r_2) = e^{i\theta} \psi(r_2, r_1)
$$

This topological protection enables fault-tolerant quantum memory resistant to perturbations that would otherwise disrupt `QUANTUM-ENTANGLEMENT`.
